caption: Fig. 2.15 Boundary surface diagrams of the five 3d orbitals.
note: Five axis diagrams arranged (a) upper left, (b) upper right, (c) middle left, (d) middle right, (e) lower centre; each panel carries its orbital name above in red, the three axis letters z, x, y on the artwork, and its panel letter below. Labels are listed panel by panel in that reading order, and within each panel as orbital name, z, x, y, panel letter - the three axis letters are given in that fixed order because their printed positions differ only marginally between panels and the flat list cannot show which panel an axis letter belongs to. Subscripts are printed as subscripts and are written here with an underscore; in d_x²–y² and d_z² the 2 is printed as a superscript inside the subscript, and the dash in d_x²–y² is printed as a minus sign. Lobes and arrowheads are artwork, not labels. Excluded from the grown crop (outside target_box_in_crop): the paragraph above the panel ("designations 2p_x, 2p_y, and 2p_z. ..."), the whole right-hand column including the heading "2.6.3 Energ...", and the footer "2024-25".
